messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — quick ask. Noticing a latency regression for opt-13b-v2 on hosted routes: TTFT p95 up ~30% since yesterday's rollout. Where's the authoritative place to check TTFT, tokens/sec, and traces? Trying to triage whether it's a runtime regress or a model change.

Jon Patel: Start with Grafana -> "Inference / Latency / Per-route" dashboard. Look at the TTFT panel (group by route + model). Also check the Tokens/sec panel next to it. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/inf-latency/per-route?orgId=1

Jon Patel: Relevant PromQLs:
```
# TTFT p95 for route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(response_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, route, model))

# tokens/sec aggregated by model
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (model)
```

Sara Gomez: If you need traces, go to Jaeger -> "inference-service" and filter by trace.tags.route=/v1/generate and tag model=opt-13b-v2. Look for spans with long "wait_for_batch" or heavy KV cache loads. Jaeger link: https://jaeger.internal/query?service=inference-service

Lee Wong: Also check the runtime per-instance tokens/sec metric (metric name: runtime_tokens_per_sec) — if a single instance is saturated you'll see high queue time and TTFT rises. Grafana panel is on the same dashboard but the node-level panels live under "Inference / Hosts".

infra-bot: ALERT fired: ttft_p95_high (route=/v1/generate, model=opt-13b-v2) — value=1.32s > threshold=1.0s. Incident: #inc-4723

Devon Park: Two quick triage steps: 1) confirm whether token length distribution changed (check request_size_histogram). 2) confirm rollout time — was a model swap or config change around the regression timestamp? Use deploys dashboard -> check last 24h.

Anita Li: For logs, use Kibana: index inference-logs-* and filter request.route:/v1/generate AND model:opt-13b-v2 AND @timestamp:[now-1h TO now]. Watch for repeated upstream timeouts or heavy decode warnings. Kibana link: https://kibana.internal/app/discover#/?index=inference-logs-*

Anita Li: If we need to tune the alert, open a PR against infra/alerts/ttft.rules.yaml. Suggestion: add a suppression window and increase p95 threshold for that route by 15% while we investigate. I can pick this up if someone approves. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Great, thanks — I'm pulling the TTFT p95 panel now. I also ran the token-length query and saw a 2x increase in requests >1024 tokens around the same time. Could be a client change.

Jon Patel: If token lengths jumped, check cache hit rate panel (kv_cache_hit_ratio). Heavy long-context requests will blow cache efficiency. Panel query: sum(kv_cache_hits) / sum(kv_cache_requests) by (model)

Devon Park: If we need an immediate mitigation, consider temporarily routing opt-13b-v2 traffic to the cooler pool (dedicated-capacity), or enable prefix caching override for that route. Both require a small rollout change.

Anita Li: I'll open the alert PR and a quick runbook update. @Maria can you paste the exact spike time and a sample request_id so I can link logs in the PR?

Maria Chen: Spike started ~2024-12-03T18:12:00Z, sample request_id=rid_8f3c2b. Adding to the incident thread #inc-4723.

Lee Wong: FYI I'll add a dashboard bookmark for the filtered p95 + tokens/sec view and push to the observability quicklinks so others can find it.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — assigning follow-ups: Anita alert PR, Lee dashboard bookmark, Jon trace + kernel check, Devon routing mitigation plan. Will update the incident. :rocket:
